summary: TFA Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K disclosing an offshore private placement of up to 5,952,381 ordinary shares at $2.52 per share, aiming to raise up to $15 million. Multiple closings are permitted with no minimum; shares are sold under Regulation S to non-U.S. persons only. Proceeds will fund TFA-01 development and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural complexities beyond the offering terms are noted. The filing serves as a notice under Rule 135c; the offering remains open with no assurance of completion.
